data.title: Agomab Moves Inhaled IPF Drug AGMB-447 Into Phase 2 After Positive Phase 1 Results
data.description:
An update from AgomAb Therapeutics NV ADR ( (AGMB) ) is now available.

On September 14, 2026, Agomab Therapeutics reported topline Phase 1 data for AGMB‑447 in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, showing a generally favorable safety and tolerability profile at 4.5 mg twice daily via inhalation. The study also confirmed low systemic but high pulmonary exposure and robust ALK5 target engagement, with bronchoalveolar lavage levels and pSMAD3 reduction consistent with prior results in healthy participants.

The company disclosed that it has submitted a Clinical Trial Application for INSPIRIA, a 24‑week Phase 2 randomized, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled study of AGMB‑447 in about 120 IPF patients, and plans to start the trial in the second half of 2026. By moving AGMB‑447 into Phase 2 and designing the study to assess lung function via forced vital capacity on top of standard of care, Agomab is advancing a potentially differentiated inhaled anti‑fibrotic therapy in a market where current treatments only slow disease progression and carry significant tolerability issues for patients.

data.title: Vaxart Adopts New Director Resignation and Ownership Policies
data.description:
Vaxart ( (VXRT) ) has issued an announcement.

On September 3, 2026, Vaxart’s Board of Directors adopted a Director Resignation Policy requiring any director in an uncontested election who receives more “withhold” than “for” votes to promptly offer their resignation. The Nominating and Governance Committee must review the offer and make a recommendation, and the Board must decide whether to accept or reject the resignation within 90 days of certification of the shareholder vote.

On the same date, the Board approved a Director Stock Ownership Policy setting a target ownership level for non-employee directors at twice the current annual cash retainer for Board service. The policy measures compliance annually using a 90-day simple moving average of the company’s share price, and counts both directly or indirectly owned stock and service-vesting share-based awards toward the ownership requirement, underscoring an effort to better align director incentives with shareholder interests.

data.title: QVC Group Issues Cautionary Bankruptcy Operating Reports
data.description:
The latest update is out from QVC Group, Inc. ( (QVCG) ).

On April 16, 2026, QVC Group, Inc. and affiliated entities filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Texas to implement a prepackaged reorganization plan. The court confirmed the plan on July 20, 2026, and the company parties emerged from Chapter 11 on August 6, 2026, marking the formal completion of the court-supervised restructuring process.

To comply with bankruptcy reporting requirements, the company parties filed monthly operating reports on September 11, 2026, covering financial data as of July 31, 2026 and activity for July. QVC cautioned that these unaudited reports, prepared solely for Bankruptcy Code compliance and differing from regular Exchange Act reporting, may be subject to future adjustments and should not be relied upon as indicative of its current or future consolidated financial condition or performance.
